name: Reporting Record Status 1 Code
definition: Specifies the status of the processing of an individual record within a message.

ACPD.name: Accepted After Pending
ACPD.definition: Record has been accepted, following a pending status.

PDNG.name: Pending
PDNG.definition: Processing of the record is pending (some validation rules have been executed but some have not and the final status is not known yet).

RCVD.name: Received
RCVD.definition: Recrod has been received but not processed yet.

RJPD.name: Rejected After Pending
RJPD.definition: Record has been rejected, following a pending status.

WARN.name: Warning
WARN.definition: Record has been accepted with warnings.
